logging/write#

Destinations of log records, and ways to combine them.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

BroadcastLogs(TextStreamLogs(Stderr()), file_logs);           // to each
FallbackLogs(primary: syslog, fallback: TextStreamLogs(Stderr()));
BestEffortLogs(file_logs);                                    // never throws
let kept = CollectedLogs();                                   // for tests

Destinations of log records, and ways to combine them.
